name: get_context
description: Read the active page, viewport, selection, revision, and available boards. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: select_page
description: Select a page by its raw page ID and return refreshed context. Refuses active user edits; old page aliases cannot target the new page. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: get_tree
description: Read an ordered layer tree. Depth defaults to 4; output is capped at 400 nodes. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: get_html
description: Export a layer as editable HTML with inline styles. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: get_styles
description: Read computed CSS styles of up to 50 layers. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: find
description: Search layer text, type, or name inside an optional subtree. Returns at most 50 matches. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: screenshot
description: Capture a settled layer or page. Slice mode supports zero-based slices; overview fits the scene. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: write_html
description: Insert sanitized HTML with inline CSS relative to a target layer. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: write_svg
description: Insert SVG as editable vector layers; unsupported elements are preserved as pictures with warnings. Standalone operation. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: get_path
description: Read native cubic path segments and node indices in world coordinates. Use the returned revision when editing. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: edit_path
description: Edit native path nodes in world coordinates. Requires the revision from get_path; standalone atomic operation. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: boolean
description: Combine ordered vector operands non-destructively. Subtract removes later operands from the first. Flatten creates an editable path and hides preserved sources; other operations retain source children. Standalone operation. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: outline
description: Convert strokes or text into editable paths while preserving hidden source layers. Standalone atomic operation. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: image
description: Remove an image background locally or restore its preserved original. Standalone atomic operation. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: update
description: Update a layer using CSS declarations, text, or supported attributes. An empty CSS value removes a property. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: move
description: Move a layer before or after a sibling, or first or last inside a container. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: duplicate
description: Duplicate a subtree, optionally positioning the copy relative to a target. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: delete
description: Remove up to 200 layers atomically, including their descendants. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: batch
description: Apply 1–100 supported writes atomically as one agent operation. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: create_board
description: Create a vertically laid-out board to the right of existing boards. Height hugs content when omitted. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: assets
description: Search configured local or optional asset providers. Unconfigured providers return no records. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: get_guide
description: Read practical guidance for layout, text, review, components, vector authoring, or local image editing. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: undo
description: Undo the latest edit only when it belongs to this agent. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: components
description: Search reusable components, with pages of at most 200 records. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: component
description: Create or modify reusable components, variants, instances, and typed properties atomically. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: fonts
description: List configured font families, optionally filtering by a case-insensitive query. Optional documentId targets a document; otherwise uses this MCP session’s binding, never the visible tab.

name: page
description: List, create, rename, duplicate, delete, reorder or update page guides. Returns refreshed page context. Keeps at least one page; copies remap layer and component identities. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: create_shape
description: Create a native editable shape with explicit geometry and inspector properties, without drawing gestures. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: edit_shapes
description: Atomically edit explicit layers using native inspector properties, structure, geometry, layout or arrangement operations. Never uses the human selection. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: edit_text
description: Edit rich text ranges and paragraph styles, or find and replace text while preserving unaffected runs. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: styles
description: Manage shared paint, text and effect styles; inspect users, apply and detach styles. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: libraries
description: Manage embedded component library snapshots, enable or unlink them, insert instances and export snapshots. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: document_assets
description: Manage embedded images, SVG and font assets. Sources must be embedded data URLs; no implicit filesystem or network fetch. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: clipboard
description: Copy or cut native layers and properties to a private agent clipboard or explicit transferable payload; paste in place, at coordinates or replacing explicit layers. Does not read the system clipboard. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: view
description: Read or set canvas viewport, selection, tool and display flags, or fit explicit layers. Changes are targeted to this document. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: export_selection
description: Export explicit layers as SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP, PDF, HTML or editable JSON. Returns typed content or base64; no save dialog. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: redo
description: Redo only an edit previously undone by this agent, without consuming another user or agent history. Requires explicit documentId; never targets the visible tab implicitly.

name: list_documents
description: List local canvas metadata without opening a document. Optional query, zero-based offset and limit (default 50, maximum 100). No paths, thumbnails or document content.

name: open_document
description: Open and bind a local canvas by its document ID. Keeps other documents and sessions open. focus defaults to false; true reveals its tab. Returns document identity and context.

name: create_document
description: Create and bind a blank local canvas, optionally named with 1–120 characters. focus defaults to false; true reveals its tab. Returns its saved document ID and context.

name: rename_document
description: Rename a local canvas by document ID without switching the open canvas. The trimmed title must contain 1–120 characters.

name: duplicate_document
description: Flush and duplicate the specified canvas, optionally naming the copy. Binds the caller to the new document. focus defaults to false; true reveals its tab.

name: workspace
description: Inspect tabs, focus or close an explicit document, show the library, inspect public connection/app information, control the app window or request a saved quit. Closing may release only this caller’s binding.

name: preferences
description: Read or update display name, library view and an explicit document favorite.

name: save_document
description: Flush and durably save an explicit canvas without changing the visible tab.

name: delete_document
description: Delete an unused canvas only when expectedTitle matches. Close and release its agent binding first; other agents or collaborators prevent deletion.

name: import_document
description: Import .omc or canvas JSON from a bounded payload or explicit absolute local file path; .fig and .sketch require filePath without a dialog. Opening stays in the background by default.

name: export_document
description: Export a targeted canvas to typed content or an explicit absolute file path. Existing files are preserved unless overwrite is explicitly true.

name: import_resource
description: Import an image, SVG, font or library snapshot from an explicit bounded local file into a targeted canvas. Uses no file dialog or HTTP body expansion.

name: collaboration
description: Inspect, host, create invitations, join or leave an explicitly targeted collaboration session. Network actions happen only when requested; invitations grant edit access.
